_about: 909 reference candidate for Analog BD 0.1.4-experimental. Independently fitted to Skee Mask’s supplied 70 BPM Tune/Attack sweeps on 9 October 2026. Recordings remain private. No assumption of uniformly spaced physical knob positions; steady harmonics and transient endpoints are the calibration targets.

tune._tune0: Short-sweep endpoint retuned against aligned recorded trigger edges; excursion no longer doubles at minimum TUNE. Intermediate response is a design interpolation, not a measured knob-position fit.

body.c_note: Degree-11 body harmonic-magnitude fit to the supplied 70 BPM Attack sweep. Fundamental gain and steady DC retained; minimum-attack hits 2..13 (one-based) fit the shape independently of transient noise. Original pitch/decay/accent/desk curves retained.

pulse._note: Two discharges share the unchanged HP/resonant LP/output pole. Fast onset decays in 30 us; longer Attack discharge is 5 ms. Fit endpoints hit stated bounds and are model choices. Quarter-scale mixed excitation preserves native filter headroom. jitter_* vary strength, never timing.

mackie._note: SAT / LOW / HIGH: a Mackie-desk stage after the 909's output, with airwindows MackEQ (Chris Johnson, MIT) as the reference, not a port: its clip + x - k_sat x^5 curve at the input, in the bass and high bands and at the output stage, its band drive law 4u^2 and its one-pole crossover coefficients, and its output stage 9 dB (stage) above its input stage. Unlike MackEQ the split is complementary and each band's output is sqrt(2u), so LOW 64 / HIGH 64 is flat and SAT 0 is transparent (-75 dB from dry on the init patch).
mackie.rise_note: Unpadded RMS (0-300 ms, init patch, LOW/HIGH 64) above SAT 0, measured on the float design; the make-up table holds the rise to target_rise_db at SAT 127.
mackie.hp_note: The desk's input is AC-coupled (MackEQ's k_hp, ~13 Hz at 44.1 kHz); without it the 909's DC thump, times SAT's drive, pins the input stage and leaves a DC shelf after every hit. Its coefficient ramps from 0 at SAT 0 (DC-coupled, the calibrated 909) to k_hp at SAT hp_full, so the knob has no step.
